name: J-Pe
source: J-Pe is the current darling of XIX's management company, PYRO. He's just old enough to rub his seniority in Aigburth's face. A former child actor with an established fan following, J-Pe makes it clear from day one that he's here for fame, fortune, and to be a massive sell-out. You really can't fault him for being honest.
